query:
SELECT 
  u.username,
  c.id,
  c.name,
  ccf.fieldName,
  ccf.fieldValue
FROM contacts c
INNER JOIN users u ON c.parentUserId = u.id
LEFT JOIN contact_custom_fields ccf ON c.id = ccf.contactId AND ccf.fieldName = '公司名称'
WHERE u.username IN ('Jiang', 'yunting')
ORDER BY u.username, c.name;
